title: My DIL Forged My Signature, Stole $760K, Sent A Basket. So I Put Her In A Slippery Trust Smock.
description: After I cashed out my $123K widow’s pension to start a soap company with my daughter-in-law, she forged our dissolution and sold the brand for $760K, sending me a $4,500 guilt basket. But I had hidden the original contract inside a hollow soap mold, and now she cuts every bar of Lather of Lies Soaps wearing a 'Slippery Trust' smock. #SoapRevenge #FamilyBetrayal #JusticeServed
thumb_text: SHE FORGED MY SIGNATURE, NOW SHE CUTS MY SOAP
pinned_comment: If my daughter-in-law had forged my signature and sent me a $4,500 guilt basket after I poured my $123K widow’s pension into our dream, what would you have done? Tell me your story in the comments.

thumb_lines.text: I HID THE ORIGINAL CONTRACT IN A SOAP MOLD
